name: route-planner
description: Turn an established GPX route into a detailed multi-day itinerary with researched detours, accurate distance and ascent, and per-day GPX exports.

scripts.test: node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/test-site.mjs && node scripts/test-features.mjs && node scripts/test-exports.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run analyse
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm test && npx --yes netlify-cli@latest deploy --prod --dir=site
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npm test && npx --yes netlify-cli@latest deploy --dir=site
scripts.deploy:anon: npm run build && npm test && npx --yes netlify-cli@latest deploy --dir=site --allow-anonymous
